Elements.Script:
getgenv().PlaceSpeed = 0.5
getgenv().PlaceMode = 'Random High'
Value:AddSlider('PlaceSpeed', {
    Title = 'Place Delay',
    Min = 0.01,
    Max = 5,
    Default = 0.5,
    Rounding = 0.01,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().PlaceSpeed = V
    end
})
Value:AddDropdown('PlaceMode', {
    Title = 'Place Position',
    Values = {'Random High', '0,0,0', 'Forward', 'Max Height'},
    Default = 'Random High',
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().PlaceMode = V
    end
})
Value:AddToggle('AutoPlace', {
    Title = 'Auto Place',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        if V then
            getgenv().AutoPlace = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local remote = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.Events.PlaceDomino
                local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
                while getgenv().AutoPlace do
                    local char = lp.Character
                    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    local cf = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
                    local mode = getgenv().PlaceMode
                    if mode == 'Forward' and root then
                        cf = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -5)
                    elseif mode == 'Max Height' and root then
                        cf = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, 1000, root.Position.Z)
                    elseif mode == 'Random High' and root then
                        local rx, rz = math.random(-50, 50), math.random(-50, 50)
                        cf = CFrame.new(root.Position.X + rx, 1000, root.Position.Z + rz)
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        remote:FireServer('Domino', cf)
                    end)
                    task.wait(getgenv().PlaceSpeed or 0.5)
                end
            end)
        else
            getgenv().AutoPlace = false
        end
    end
})

getgenv().CatchSpeed = 0.1
Value:AddSlider('CatchSpeed', {
    Title = 'Catch Delay',
    Min = 0.01,
    Max = 5,
    Default = 0.1,
    Rounding = 0.01,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().CatchSpeed = V
    end
})
Value:AddToggle('AutoCatch', {
    Title = 'Auto Catch',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        if V then
            getgenv().AutoCatch = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local remote = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Remotes.Events.CatchFailedFall
                local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
                local userIdStr = tostring(lp.UserId)
                while getgenv().AutoCatch do
                    pcall(function()
                        local dFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild('Dominos')
                        if dFolder then
                            local userFolder = dFolder:FindFirstChild(userIdStr)
                            if userFolder then
                                for _, item in ipairs(userFolder:GetChildren()) do
                                    if item:FindFirstChild('ColorPart') then
                                        remote:FireServer(item)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(getgenv().CatchSpeed or 0.1)
                end
            end)
        else
            getgenv().AutoCatch = false
        end
    end
})
